Why aren't the aliens here already ?

Speculation time!

Maybe they believe in survival of the fittest and are waiting to see whether we solve our sociopathic leadership problem before we annihilate ourselves. I can't imagine a species that has mastered space travel helping a species led by toxic, greedy, psychopathic leaders to spread through the stars.

If you can't play nice with yourself, you can't play nice with others.

What if they are here, but we aren't the focus of their observation? Maybe they're waiting for us to go extinct so a more cooperative Earth species has a chance to flourish, instead.

It is so very like us, so arrogant and self-important, to think we'd actually be worth a space-faring alien species' time. There could have been countless races like ours who have destroyed themselves along the same predictable pattern. We could be a textbook example, to aliens, of how to fail at reaching the stars.

Maybe self-destruction before achieving space travel is extremely common. We'd never see them.
That's the idea behind much of Star Trek. Specifically the Vulcans not contacting a people until they attain warp capability. Same with the Prime Directive.

cause our milkshake doesn't bring the aliens to the yard. :/ I think they just give no fucks about us. Why us. why the planet with the mammals who can't cooperate to save themselves? They have literally everywhere else go to. Maybe they cant see us, i've seen that we're in the bum fuck countryside of the galaxy. Alien: ahhh naww, nothing of importance over there. Naw.

Relative to a geological scale humanity hasn't been around for that long, also where we live just isn't that interesting a place. Although, that said, we may be living in a solar system that is unusually stable, since most of our observations are supporting the theory that gas giant tend to gravitate closer to suns then our's seem to have.

The point that I'm trying to make is that it's not about how long aliens have been around or what they've been doing with their time but rather how long humans humans have been around. Wondering why aliens haven't arrived yet is a little like wondering why you've not seen anyone for the last five minutes when you're out in the middle of Nebraska.
Why aren't the aliens here already ?

Think about it, man. If you had never met a human being before, never heard of Earth before, and you started monitoring the civilization remotely, what would you see, and how would you react to it? Now ask yourself the original question again.
"Look at all this pornography....my god this species is obsessed with making love. I bet they've never had a war in their entire history"

What if their existence is so fundamentally different from ours that we don't notice them and they don't notice us?

What if there are things that aren't visible to our senses, and to who's senses we're not visible that have come to exist?

In addition to all the atoms and particles we have discovered, what is there are other forms of "things"? (won't say matter because they may not have matter.)

What if there is a sentient being in the same room as you totally unaware of your presence?

It's a possibility, but I doubt it. Say they were made of dark matter (or maybe neutrinos though that is far less likely), and the only interactions were gravitational. There still are interactions however. There are cosmologists who speculate about a 'shadow universe' of dark matter, but this is very much speculation.
